name: Beaver Desk
tagline: Front-desk software for dentists who'd rather be looking at teeth.
positioning: Beaver Desk runs scheduling, recalls, and insurance claims for solo and small dental practices — so you spend less time chasing no-shows.

hero.h1: Your front desk, minus the front desk drama.
hero.sub: Beaver Desk handles booking, recalls, reminders, and claims so your one-person practice runs like it has a whole ops team. It doesn't. It has you and a good gnaw.

features.title: Recalls that actually recall
features.description: Auto-nudge patients overdue for a cleaning by text and email until they book — no spreadsheet, no sticky notes, no 'I'll call them Monday.'

features.title: Claims without the sighing
features.description: Submit and track insurance claims from one screen, catch rejections before payers do, and see exactly which ones are stuck and why.

features.title: A schedule that fills its own gaps
features.description: When someone cancels at 8:40am, Beaver Desk offers the slot to your waitlist automatically. The chair rarely sits empty and neither do you.

features.title: Reminders people don't ignore
features.description: Confirmations, pre-visit forms, and post-op instructions go out on autopilot. No-show rates drop; awkward voicemails disappear.

features.title: Numbers you can read sober
features.description: Production, collections, and open chair time in plain language — not a 40-tab report you'll never open.

features.title: Setup measured in minutes
features.description: Import your patient list, connect your calendar, and go. No six-week onboarding, no consultant in a polo.

testimonials.quote: I fired the practice-management suite that cost more than my compressor. Beaver Desk does the two things I actually needed and stopped nagging me to buy modules.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: Our no-show rate went from embarrassing to boring. The waitlist auto-fill alone paid for the year in a week.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: Claims used to be my Sunday night hobby. Now I actually know which ones a payer is sitting on, and I email them instead of guessing.
testimonials.name: Tara Nowak

pricing.blurb: For the single-chair operation that wears every hat.
For the small team that's tired of babysitting the calendar.
For the mini-empire running more than one chair-filled room.

homepage.footerBlurb: Beaver Desk keeps small dental practices booked, reminded, and paid — without the enterprise price tag or the six-week onboarding.
